_why: Every RUSTSEC advisory this tree currently carries, so a new one fails loudly and a cleared one prompts an update to SECURITY.md. Held to `cargo audit` by scripts/check-advisories.mjs. No entry here is a vulnerability: `cargo audit` reports 0 of those, and this file must stay that way — a real vulnerability belongs fixed, not listed.

unsound.RUSTSEC-2024-0429: glib — VariantStrIter iterator unsoundness. Linux only, via GTK/WebKitGTK under Tauri. Not resolvable from here: the fix is in glib 0.20, which arrives when Tauri's GTK stack moves. Shotshelf never calls VariantStrIter.
